P2: `globals.browser` is included in the first config object that matches `service-worker.js` and `service-worker-utils.js`, but these files run in a Manifest V3 service worker (no DOM access). This allows references to `window`, `document`, `localStorage`, and similar browser-only APIs to pass lint without errors, masking `ReferenceError` runtime failures. Since `popup/` and `settings/` files (which legitimately need `globals.browser` for `document.getElementById()` etc.) are in the same config object, the fix is to split service-worker files into their own block without `globals.browser`.
